purpose: test whether forecast-conditioned public planning improves the matched service-intent baseline before formal-scale training

arms.plain_mappo: capacity-standard shared MAPPO on the same service-intent interface
arms.pscr_public_plan: public-plan MAPPO with training-only opportunity head
arms.pscr_shuffled_forecast: identical PSCR architecture with only the forecast-sector relation inverted inside the public planning channel

primary_endpoint: urgent_opposite weighted service value, with all profiles and reliability metrics reported jointly
decision_rule: Expand only when the full PSCR arm exceeds both controls on the primary endpoint in at least two of three training seeds, without a materially worse safety or energy tradeoff.
interpretation_boundary: Development pilot only; training seed is the independent unit and episode rows are within-policy estimates.
